title: 1Code: the open-source GUI that makes AI coding parallel
description:
Stop staring at your terminal waiting for Claude to finish. Meet 1Code — the open-source GUI that finally makes AI coding parallel. We all know the pain: you give Claude Code a task, and your terminal is locked for ten minutes. 1Code fixes this by wrapping the agent in a visual dashboard that lets you run multiple tasks at once. You can have one agent fixing a bug and another writing docs simultaneously—each running in its own isolated Git worktree.

https://github.com/21st-dev/1code
